Test
.`coins derive gold silver and copper from the copper total`()

.`refreshed adds a rule that is new to the table and keeps the others`()
.`refreshed re-rolls a queue that left the rule range`()
.`refreshed keeps the stored queue of a rule missing from the table`()
.`refreshed twice returns the same drops in the same order`()
.`dropsFor returns the queues of table rules only`()
.`credit adds the queued values of every rule and reports accepted kills per rule`()
.`credit discards kills above the allowance of each rule`()
.`credit refills each queue and keeps the queues it was not asked about unchanged`()
.`credit with no kills or only zero counts leaves the wallet unchanged`()
.`credit rejects an unknown rule and credits nothing even for the valid ones`()
.`credit clamps the total at the largest 64-bit value`()
.`plus adds copper and clamps at the 64-bit total`()
.`minus takes copper down to exactly zero`()
